reddit.title: Introducing Improved Unit Movement in Provincia
reddit.body: In our latest devtalk, we discuss significant changes to unit movement mechanics in Provincia. Formation drags now align soldiers based on your direction, ensuring a more realistic march without teleportation. Attacks from behind will no longer cause units to wheel through one another, enhancing tactical gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
